item.title: Version 1.0.35
item.description:
fix + redesign: "Time regained" stat

- Visual: silver chrome value flanked by em-dashes (FLIPPED wordmark
  style), with "TIME REGAINED" mono caps label below.  Bigger,
  prouder, more trophy-like.
- Copy: dropped "Precious" — just "TIME REGAINED".
- Bug fix (server-side, already deployed): manual Home FLIP sessions
  no longer cause the totalSecondsFlipped stat to drift upward
  after unflipping.  Backend now stamps an ended_at on every session
  completion + the stats SQL uses it.
